'''Kashyyyk Train of Dominance''' ('''KToD''') is a New England Star Wars CCG playtest team that formed around 2002, taking its name from Decipher's Kashyyyk region. The Players Committee Hall of Fame entry for [[Justin Desai]] credits KToD versions of Combat, Profit, and Hunt Down, and "legendary KToD Senate," plus Worlds team championships in 2007 and 2008.<ref name="hof">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/ Awards and Hall of Fame], Players Committee</ref>

A 2024 community spotlight described the group as culminating in five world championships, several team world championships, and countless majors.<ref name="gr">[https://garbagerollers.com/2024/02/02/community-spotlight-ktod-feb-2nd-2024/ Community Spotlight: KToD], Garbage Rollers (2 February 2024)</ref>

Chu was already a long-standing member of [[Team Albany]] in the Decipher era; KToD is a later affiliation.
